RETROSPECTIVE TEMPLATE — use when finishing each phase.

Retro is an Agile team ritual: pause to look back so you can move faster next time.
Doing it alone is still valuable — even more valuable, because no one else will remind you.
The only rule: HONESTY. A rose-tinted retro is a useless retro.
-->
